mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_auth_sso_login_code ( code_hash, user_id, return_path, expires_at ) VALUES ( #{codeHash}, #{userId}, #{returnPath}, DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL #{ttlSeconds} SECOND) )
mapper.select: SELECT user_id, return_path FROM t_auth_sso_login_code WHERE code_hash = #{codeHash} AND consumed_at IS NULL AND expires_at > NOW(3) FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE t_auth_sso_login_code SET consumed_at = NOW(3) WHERE code_hash = #{codeHash} AND consumed_at IS NULL
